# Thermal Mast TM-2

The Thermal Mast TM-2 is a ten-metre mast with a thermal camera that watches
the moor for hot spots. It is made by [[velloria-optics]] and stored at the
[[harrowgate-annex]].

## Calibration

During the fire season the camera is calibrated every two weeks; in winter,
once a month.
